mechanism: one Agent subagent per lane, each in an isolated git worktree; lane commits merged into the execution branch by the operator; downstream sha pins refreshed afterwards in fo_a9_apply_state_integration by rebuilding in the registered order (P4, XE, P1, P2, P3, MP, RFQ, RVM, owner-question state, M16)
binding: no numerical value is invented: only owner-supplied numbers (k_loss = k_agreement = k_transition = 2.0, 1.20 bound factor, 50/100/25 W allocation, 600 W temporary allocation, 50 K, 10 K) are entered; every other value stays a registration with its registration point
decision files, CLAUDE.md, HISTORY, runtime state, ledgers and owner-question state are not edited by lane agents
no production model, frozen dataset or golden change in this wave (A9.9 model changes are separate controlled changes)
